Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production VFX sprite atlas for a dark fantasy 2D Unity RPG, NOT a presentation or an illustration scene. Create ONE transparent PNG atlas with exactly 32 SEPARATE, individually usable effect sprites arranged in an EXACT uniform 8-column by 4-row grid, reading left to right, top to bottom. Landscape canvas, 3:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1536x1024. Each of the 32 invisible cells is identical size; each sprite is centered on its own cell, fully contained in the middle 70% of the cell. Leave the other 30% as completely transparent padding. No sprite touches a cell edge or another sprite. No grid lines, no labels, no text, no numbers, no UI frames, no background, no floor, no characters. Real transparent alpha, not a checkerboard image. Style: polished hand-painted JRPG combat effects with strong legible silhouettes, bright ivory/silver-white cores, fine translucent smoky/energy edges and restrained luminous detail. Predominantly monochrome white and cool silver so Unity can tint each sprite. NOT flat vector icons, NOT black outline clip art, NOT solid black blobs.
